ruleDefinitions.name: Potential PsExec Remote Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential psexec command that initiate execution on a remote systems via common commandline flags used by the utility

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*accepteula.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-p\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\\\\\\\.*")) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\\\localhost.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\\\\\127\\\..*")))
